newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - July 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi municipal and rural affairs ministry signs a 58 million riyal contract to build a major water supply network.
- More than 20 electronics and toy shops in Jeddah were gutted by a fire on Sunday.
- Islamic Development Bank approved $256 million in loans and special grants to finance development projects in member countries.
- Saudi Arabia executed an Afghan in Jeddah for smuggling heroin.
- Saudi Arabia's annual consumption of gold stands at 250 tonnes.
- Saudi finance and national economy ministry began imposing a 100 percent customs tariff on cigarettes and other tobacco products from July 1.
